source_sql:
WITH docs AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT source_id,source_sha256,content_bytes,content_text FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.source_document WHERE source_id LIKE 'S01:FINRA_CNMS:2026-%'),
lines AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT d.source_id,t.ord, string_to_array(trim(trailing E'\r' from t.line),'|') f FROM docs d CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(string_to_array(d.content_text,E'\n')) WITH ORDINALITY t(line,ord) WHERE t.line ~ '^[0-9]{8}[|]'),
expected AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT *,f[3]::numeric sv,f[4]::numeric ev,f[5]::numeric tv FROM lines),
checked AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT e.*,o.source_id oid,o.values_json v,o.lineage,o.effective_date,o.source_published_at,o.historical_received_at,
o.available_at,o.availability_policy,o.normalization_sha256
FROM expected e LEFT JOIN population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.source_observation o ON o.source_id=e.source_id AND o.family_id='S01' AND o.source_record_key=e.ord::text)
SELECT source_id,count(*) source_rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE oid IS NULL) missing_observations,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE f[2] IS DISTINCT FROM v->>'symbol' OR f[6] IS DISTINCT FROM v->>'market' OR to_date(f[1],'YYYYMMDD') IS DISTINCT FROM effective_date) identity_field_errors,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE sv IS DISTINCT FROM (v->>'short_volume')::numeric OR ev IS DISTINCT FROM (v->>'short_exempt_volume')::numeric OR tv IS DISTINCT FROM (v->>'total_volume')::numeric) exact_decimal_differences,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE float8send(sv::float8) IS DISTINCT FROM float8send((v->>'short_volume')::float8) OR float8send(ev::float8) IS DISTINCT FROM float8send((v->>'short_exempt_volume')::float8) OR float8send(tv::float8) IS DISTINCT FROM float8send((v->>'total_volume')::float8)) binary_numeric_errors,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE float8send(CASE WHEN tv>0 THEN sv::float8/tv::float8 ELSE NULL END) IS DISTINCT FROM float8send((v->>'short_volume_ratio')::float8)) ratio_errors,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE sv<0 OR ev<0 OR tv<0 OR sv>tv OR ev>sv) source_arithmetic_anomalies,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE source_published_at IS NOT NULL OR historical_received_at IS NOT NULL) temporal_nonnull_rows
FROM checked GROUP BY source_id ORDER BY source_id;
projection_sql:
WITH companies AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT * FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.working_accepted_companies_v1), dates AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT right(source_id,10)::date session_date FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.source_document WHERE source_id LIKE 'S01:FINRA_CNMS:2026-%'),
points AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT company_id,session_date,count(*) point_rows,min(ticker) ticker,bool_and(dated_anchor_point_and_source_value_link_verified) point_verified FROM (SELECT a.company_id,o.session_date,a.anchor_ticker ticker,o.point_source_state='VERIFIED_POINT_AND_SOURCE_LINK' dated_anchor_point_and_source_value_link_verified FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.d02_anchor_source_point_v2 o JOIN companies a ON a.selection_order=o.company_ordinal CROSS JOIN population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.d02_anchor_source_completion_v2 c WHERE c.singleton AND c.status='COMPLETE_INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED' AND a.cohort_sha256=c.cohort_sha256 AND a.membership_acceptance_sha256=c.membership_acceptance_sha256 AND c.verified_grid_manifest_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND c.independent_review_event_id IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT count(*) FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.d02_anchor_source_checkpoint_v2)=42 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.d02_anchor_source_point_v2)=126000) points_base GROUP BY company_id,session_date),
reports AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT effective_date session_date,values_json->>'symbol' ticker,count(*) report_rows,min(record_sha256) report_sha FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.source_observation WHERE family_id='S01' GROUP BY effective_date,values_json->>'symbol'),
cells AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT c.company_id,d.session_date,p.ticker,p.point_rows,p.point_verified,r.report_rows,r.report_sha,
CASE WHEN p.point_rows IS DISTINCT FROM 1 OR p.point_verified IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN 'DATED_IDENTITY_HELD'
WHEN r.report_rows IS NULL THEN 'NO_RETAINED_REPORT_FOR_DATED_SYMBOL'
WHEN r.report_rows<>1 THEN 'MULTIPLE_REPORTS_REQUIRE_MARKET_RULE'
ELSE 'DATED_POINT_SOURCE_LINK_ONLY' END state
FROM companies c CROSS JOIN dates d LEFT JOIN points p USING(company_id,session_date) LEFT JOIN reports r ON r.session_date=d.session_date AND r.ticker=p.ticker)
SELECT clock_timestamp() checked_at,session_date,count(*) selected_company_cells,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE state='DATED_POINT_SOURCE_LINK_ONLY') candidate_links,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE state='DATED_IDENTITY_HELD') identity_held,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE state='NO_RETAINED_REPORT_FOR_DATED_SYMBOL') no_retained_report,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE state='MULTIPLE_REPORTS_REQUIRE_MARKET_RULE') multiple_reports,
encode(sha256(convert_to(string_agg(jsonb_build_array(company_id,session_date,ticker,point_rows,point_verified,report_rows,report_sha,state)::text,E'\n' ORDER BY company_id),'UTF8')),'hex') projection_sha256
FROM cells GROUP BY session_date ORDER BY session_date;
